mcp_tools.name: claim_verification_fact_check_stamp
mcp_tools.title: Claim verification fact check stamp
mcp_tools.description: Submit a claim-verification manifest (declared claims with labels, source records and re-check records, plus the publication process record); get a deterministic STAMPED / NOT_STAMPED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE stamp across six sections, including per-claim triangulation and math re-derivation checks that name offending claims, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The claim-verification manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and claim-row schema).

process.description: Publication-process evidence (extraction, corrections policy, versions, silent edits).

claims.description: Declared claims: {id, material, label, independent_sources, primary_source, sources_archived, source_metadata_recorded, independence_checked, has_numbers, math_rechecked, language_weakest_supported}.

expect.notes: All 16 checks pass. computed_spot_checks: claims_total=1, material_claims=1, verified_claims=1

checks.evidence: isolate every checkable unit — one row per claim
for each source: who, when, method, sample, conflicts of interest recorded
independence checked — two sources citing each other are one source
quality gate: every material claim has at least one archived source
material claims need >= 2 independent sources, or one primary source plus confirmation
re-derive math for claims carrying numbers
sanity-check units and orders of magnitude; verify dates and name spellings
quality gate: counter-case considered; 'what would change our mind' noted for contested claims
publish with evidence: inline citations, archived links
skill red line: corrections are never silent — fast, dated, visible change log
